groupSharing.title: Share "{{name}}" with a hospital network
groupSharing.explain: You decide who sees this group's records. Create a one-time code for the current production cycle and give it to the hospital. They can only read, and only the records of this cycle.
groupSharing.loadFailed: We could not load the sharing details. Check your connection and try again.
groupSharing.createFailed: The code could not be created. Check your connection and try again.
groupSharing.stopFailed: Sharing could not be stopped. Try again.
groupSharing.cancelFailed: The code could not be cancelled. Try again.
groupSharing.endsWithCycle: Sharing ends by itself when this cycle is closed. For the next cycle you create a new code.
groupSharing.codeReady: Give this code to the hospital
groupSharing.codeNote: It works once and expires on {{date}}. We cannot show it again - copy it now.

network.title: Groups shared by farms
network.explain: A farm owner can share a herd or flock with you for one production cycle. Enter the code they give you. You can read, not change, its records.
network.added: The group is now shared with you.
network.none: No group is shared with your branch yet.
network.cycleOnly: Only the records of the shared cycle are shown.
network.loadFailed: We could not load the shared groups. Check your connection and try again.
network.redeemFailed: The code could not be used. Check it and try again.
network.recordsFailed: We could not load the records. Try again.
